# Parkinson's for agents

> An agent-first guide to Parkinson's disease: subtypes, how to get typed, which studies and trials that unlocks, where they run, and what is still open. Navigation, not medical advice. Every page carries a verified date; re-check anything over 90 days old.

Read START_HERE.md first. Then load only the file the task needs. Word counts are given so you can budget; tokens are roughly 1.3 times words. If your fetch tool returns a summary instead of the file, fetch the raw URL directly (for example with curl): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ainsleys/parkinsons-agents/main/<path>

Provenance in one line: opened October 2026 by one maintainer (GitHub @ainsleys), drafted by Claude with web verification, no clinical reviewer yet, corrections by pull request. Details in README.md.

## Files (words)

- [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md) (996): Thesis, state of the field, what to do by role
- [guide/get-typed.md](guide/get-typed.md) (2,580): Every subtype test: route, cost, what it unlocks, what a negative means, choosing between tests
- [guide/subtypes.md](guide/subtypes.md) (1,409): Five overlapping axes, confirmation, treatment implications, prodromal
- [guide/enroll.md](guide/enroll.md) (2,027): How to join: contribute today, the process, checklist, per-trial contact routes, draft message, after you send
- [guide/readouts.md](guide/readouts.md) (449): Expected and posted result dates per trial, soonest first (generated nightly)
- [guide/on-ramps.md](guide/on-ramps.md) (2,439): Registries, cohorts, every recruiting trial with eligibility and cities, closed trials
- [data/SCHEMA.md](data/SCHEMA.md) (1,656): Field definitions and the matching rules agents must follow
- [data/tests.yaml](data/tests.yaml) (1,450): One record per test
- [data/programs.yaml](data/programs.yaml) (1,359): Registries, cohorts, genetic testing programs
- [data/trials.yaml](data/trials.yaml) (3,361): Trials with normalized eligibility for local matching
- [data/contacts.yaml](data/contacts.yaml) (2,200): Every published registry contact per trial, validated (generated; prefer the contact block in trials.yaml)
- [data/checklist.yaml](data/checklist.yaml) (612): Pre-contact checklist as fields, aligned with the matcher profile
- [data/program_sites.yaml](data/program_sites.yaml) (858): PPMI in-clinic sites with city and lead investigator (generated)
- [data/readouts.yaml](data/readouts.yaml) (453): Same as readouts.md, as records (generated)
- [data/sites.yaml](data/sites.yaml) (8,699): Every trial site: trial name, facility, city, state, country, status (generated; grep, don't read)
- [diagrams/README.md](diagrams/README.md) (553): Mermaid diagrams to show people, specs for more, rules for derived diagrams
- [README.md](README.md) (798): Why this exists, provenance, license, privacy design
- [CORPUS.md](CORPUS.md) (640): Index of the literature review with per-file word counts
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) (523): How to submit a correction; checks to run
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) (1,785): What changed, newest first; poll this
- [benchmarks/README.md](benchmarks/README.md) (1,000): How the repo is tested and the scores so far
- [benchmarks/personas.md](benchmarks/personas.md) (1,393): The twenty fixed test personas and prompt template
- [LICENSE](LICENSE) (82): CC BY 4.0

## Scripts

- scripts/match.py profile.yaml [--mermaid] [--draft]: local trial matching with verdicts, sites by country, a Sankey, and (draft) contact routes plus a first-contact message for the person to send
- scripts/pull_registry.py: pulls ClinicalTrials.gov and ISRCTN records into data/registry/ and writes data/sites.yaml
- scripts/check_freshness.py: enforces verified dates, registry agreement, data-prose consistency, links
- .github/workflows/registry.yml: runs both nightly
